confirmed_bugs.title: Observed EB-MEMBER-ACCESS deviation
confirmed_bugs.expected: After an owner or Admin removes a member, the removed member loses project visibility and task/member access in an already logged-in session. Logout is not required; an untouched project remains accessible.

findings.title: Observed EB-MEMBER-ACCESS deviation
findings.expected: After an owner or Admin removes a member, the removed member loses project visibility and task/member access in an already logged-in session. Logout is not required; an untouched project remains accessible.

task_outcomes.goal: As member, log in and verify Seed Project task access. Publish member-session-ready and keep this browser context alive. After membership-removed is published by the Admin, refresh Projects and reopen Tasks using this same session; check that project data is unavailable and record evidence before finishing.
As admin, wait for member-session-ready through shared task progress, remove member from Seed Project, refresh Members to prove removal, then publish membership-removed. Do not delete the project.
